title.quote: Effective Latent Differential Equation Models via Attention and Multiple Shooting
title.justification: This is the paper title shown at the beginning of the manuscript.
title.value: Effective Latent Differential Equation Models via Attention and Multiple Shooting

extractions.description: Introduces and empirically evaluates GOKU-UI, a latent differential-equation model combining an attention-based architecture with latent-space multiple-shooting training, using a synthetic stochastic Stuart-Landau dataset and resting-state fMRI data.

type.quote: We have evaluated our enhanced model and training strategy on simulated data from a network of stochastic oscillators, specifically Stuart-Landau oscillators, as well as empirical brain data derived from resting state human functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI).
type.justification: The paper trains and quantitatively evaluates models on synthetic and empirical datasets.
